players.bio: Alexander Edward Lowry is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or left midfielder for Motherwell, on loan from Wycombe Wanderers.

Alexander Noah Paulsen is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Motherwell, on loan from Bournemouth, and the New Zealand national team. Born in Auckland, Paulsen joined the Wellington Phoenix in 2018. Initially playing for their reserve team, Paulsen signed his first professional deal in September 2021 and largely served as second-choice goalkeeper.

Alfred Johansson is a 35-year-old Swedish football manager who serves as the manager of Scottish Premiership club Motherwell FC. Appointed in June 2026, he is currently the youngest manager in the Scottish top flight.
Apostolos Vasilios Stamatelopoulos is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a striker for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell and for the Australia national team.

Callum David Hendry is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell. He was born in Lytham St Annes, England. He began his career with Blackburn Rovers, as a youth player, before being released by the club in 2017 without making an appearance.
Dylan Williams is a 22-year-old English professional footballer who plays as an attack-minded left-back for William Hill Premiership club Motherwell.

Emmanuel Longelo Mbule (born 27 December 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left back for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell. Longelo began his career with West Ham United and played first-team football in the EFL Cup and the Europa League before joining Birmingham City, initially on loan, in 2022. He spent the 2024–25 season on loan at Cambridge United.
Ewan Wilson (born 19 November 2004) is a Scottish footballer who plays as a defender for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell.
Eythor Martin Vigerust Bjørgolfsson (born 25 August 2000) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Motherwell.

Ibrahim Muhammad Said (born 15 June 2002) is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell. A product of Dabo Babes Academy in Nigeria, Said made a name for himself in football Europe after his good performance at the 2019 FIFA U-17 World Cup.

Jake Max Girdwood-Reich is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a defensive midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell. A versatile player, Girdwood-Reich can also be deployed as a central defender.

Jamie Knight-Lebel is a 21-year-old Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a centre-back for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell, on loan from EFL Championship side Bristol City. Standing at 1.88 metres (6 ft 2 in), the highly rated defender is a full senior international for the Canada men's national soccer team.

Joseph Shaun Hodge (born 14 September 2002) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership side Motherwell. Born in Manchester, England, Hodge made his senior Republic of Ireland debut in June 2026.

Joseph Shaun Hodge (born 14 September 2002) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership side Motherwell. Born in Manchester, England, Hodge made his senior Republic of Ireland debut in June 2026.
John "Johnny" Koutroumbis (born 6 March 1998) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a right back for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell.

Jordan McGhee (born 24 July 1996) is a Scottish professional footballer who currently plays for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell. He can play as either a defender, both as a centre-back and full back, or as a midfielder. He began his career at Heart of Midlothian and had a spell on loan at Middlesbrough.
Luca Ross (born Aug 11, 2006) is a Scottish football player who plays as a Centre-Forward for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell.
Lukas Fadinger (born 27 September 2000) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell.

Martin Moormann is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Motherwell. Moormann is a youth product of Sierndorf, Horn and AKA St. Pölten, before moving to Rapid Wien in 2018. He began his professional career with their reserves, before debuting for their senior team in a 3–0 Austrian Cup win over Amstetten on 28 October 2021.

Matty Connelly is a 23-year-old Scottish football player who plays as a goalkeeper for Motherwell F.C.. Born in Wishaw, Scotland, he is a product of Motherwell's youth academy, having originally joined the club when he was just four years old.
Mikey Booth (born 2 January 2007) is a Scottish footballer who plays as a Midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell.
Oscar James Moncrieff Priestman (born 25 March 2003) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a defensive midfielder for Motherwell FC.

Paul McGinn (born 22 October 1990) is a Scottish footballer, who plays as a defender for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell and the Scottish national team. He has previously played for Queen's Park, Dumbarton, Dundee, Chesterfield, Partick Thistle, St Mirren and Hibernian.

Regan Evans Charles-Cook (born 14 February 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell. Born in England, he plays for the Grenada national team. On 1 July 2021 Charles-Cook was called up to Grenada's squad for the 2021 CONCACAF Gold Cup.

Sebastian Palmer-Houlden is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell. He was previously on the books of Bristol City and played on loan for Chippenham Town, Yeovil Town, Newport County, and Dundee.
Stephen Gerard O'Donnell (born 11 May 1992) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell and the Scotland national team.
Tawanda Jethro Maswanhise (born 20 November 2002) is a Zimbabwean footballer who plays as a midfielder or winger for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell and the Zimbabwe national football team.
Thomas Lance Sparrow (born 6 December 2002) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Motherwell and the Wales under-21 national team.
Willy Gabriel Vogt Veigantes (born 1 June 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger or forward for Motherwell. Born in Brazil, he has represented Switzerland at youth level.
